snippet.title: Gameplay SIGNAL: Uncharted Lands with lead actor 🐕 #cutedog #visualnovel #gameplay #steamfest
snippet.description:
Add to wishlist ✨
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194380/SIGNAL_Uncharted_Lands/

Signal: Uncharted Lands is a visual novel set in an unusual post-apocalyptic world. Representatives of a new civilization set out in search of a mysterious signal. Where is this signal coming from? What dangers await the explorers on their journey through the uncharted wastelands? Will they reach their goal, or will something stand in their way? Find the answers to these and other questions in this novel!
------------------
